generator: tools/fx/gen_water.py (+ tools/fx/gen_water_fx.py for the fx sheets)

conventions.gspace: G = (screen x, 2 * screen y) world px = the iso ground plane seen from above (1 m = 64 G px). Water.js samples every texture with uv = G / tilePx (2:1 foreshortening like the ground). Image row 0 = v 0 = smallest G y.
conventions.data: water_waves_a / water_waves_b / water_foam / water_shore_ramp are DATA textures: plain RGB, no alpha, upload with UNPACK_PREMULTIPLY_ALPHA false and UNPACK_COLORSPACE_CONVERSION NONE, REPEAT + mipmaps (all power of two). water_lut is RGBA (A = opacity), CLAMP, no mipmaps.
conventions.module: src/systems/Water.js draws the sea with these (WebGL); Canvas fallback = ground/water_sea tileSprite.
conventions.levels: sea surface 0.55 m below land = waterPx 30 screen px (same as assets/harbor). Water.js heightAt() returns the swell height in screen px around that plane (+ = up).

images.channels: R,G = ripple normal x,y in G space (0.5 + 0.5 n); B = caustics
images.notes: FFT (JONSWAP) ripple field, 8 m tile, peak 1.4 m; sample uv = G / 512.

images.channels: R,G = ripple normal x,y; B = caustics
images.notes: Fine ripple field, 3 m physical tile; Water.js samples it at 192 G px per tile.

images.channels: R = foam lace potential (threshold it), G = bubbles / slush bits, B = low-frequency variation
images.notes: Equalised lace: threshold t covers ~ (1 - t) of the area.

images.channels: RGB = water colour, A = opacity over the bed

images.notes: wet/dry ramps per shore material: u 0 = dry, 0.5 = fresh wet, 1 = under water.
